title: Jingling Meng Yeluoli x Guang Fuchen

alternative_titles.en: The Fairy Dream of Yeloli: Light Dust

synopsis:
Centered on the dream realm of the Dream Princess from Yeloli Fairyland, the story chronicles the thousand-year saga of the Light Fairy, Bai Guangying, and the Lord of Lightning, Pang Zun, while revealing the lore of the Yeloli world. Bai Guangying and Pang Zun once forged a magical pact. For Pang Zun, the Light Fairy’s power of light served as his greatest source of strength; natural light is pure and inexhaustible, making the combination of light and electricity a perfect match. Yet, the Light Fairy cherished something far more important than power: free will. Consequently, the only one capable of truly forging a pact with her was someone who would respect and preserve that free will.

(Source: Mango TV, translated)
